anatomy.prompt: Create ONE clean editorial technical product cutaway illustration for The Bureau of Provisions website, using the reference bottle for actual external design identity. Portrait 2:3 composition, extremely sharp high-resolution 3D industrial-design rendering on uniform warm ivory #f4eddf backdrop. Bottle centred and large. A longitudinal HALF CUTAWAY: left half of cylindrical ivory stainless steel body retained with its very small navy BoP crest and simple crown/band; right half of outer shell removed cleanly to expose the water chamber and the two stainless steel body walls in cross section, clearly separate thin inner and outer metal wall with narrow intervening space. Show half of the bottom double-wall section too. The cut is a clean vertical plane through the bottle centre, no jagged edges. Steel edge faces clean metallic silver, soft pale blue water lightly visible inside chamber. A single slender straw route continues down toward the base, illustrative only. Keep the lid whole and float it a short distance directly above the body in an exploded anatomy composition: ivory lid collar, stainless steel straw and broad drinking spout, clear hinged hood open, oval front latch, small rear mist nozzle. Preserve actual bottle silhouette and proportions from reference, small complete BoP shield with both animals flanking it, very simple three-point crown and plain band, small navy animal emblem on the one visible ivory woven strap hanging beside the left wall attached by silver clips. No invented motors, batteries, filters, complicated pump mechanism, or ornate lid engineering. Do not render numeric dimensions or arrow labels or explanatory words. Reserve clear space around the object for HTML dimension lines and callouts. Diagrammatic but refined photoreal materials, orthographic front three-quarter view at a tiny angle to reveal cut faces, smooth ivory body, crisp steel, soft grounded shadow. This is a product DESIGN STUDY, not a manufacturing blueprint. Full object uncropped, lots of clean paper negative space. No people or station backdrop.

collection.prompt: Create ONE cohesive colourway collection board containing exactly TEN Bureau of Provisions bottles, arranged in a precise 5-COLUMN by 2-ROW grid, equally spaced and all identical in scale and camera angle. Each of the ten grid cells has exactly the same uniform warm ivory #f4eddf background and ample margin so each cell can be shown independently on a website. Landscape canvas, highest sharp native resolution possible. Reference image is for product identity only; remove people and station. Whole bottles uncropped with clear closed transparent hinged hood, silver steel drinking parts visible through it, oval front latch, two side metal rings, two short woven straps with tiny animal emblems, small complete navy BoP crest with greyhound and leopard, simple crown and plain band high on the body. Front-facing three-quarter studio product renders, clean crisp detail and consistent shadows. Two-tone rule: bottle body is the first colour, lid collar, latch accents and BOTH straps are the second colour. Transparent hood and neutral silver steel stay neutral. Exactly these palettes in READING ORDER: top row 1 Oxblood body #713b44 + Ballet pink accents #e5c5bc; 2 Sage body #7b8b78 + Butter accents #f0dea5; 3 Cobalt body #355eab + Cream accents #f4eddf; 4 Terracotta body #bd6e4e + Sky blue accents #b4d5e3; 5 Espresso body #4b362d + Pistachio accents #c4d09f. Bottom row 6 Lilac body #b7a4cd + Tomato red accents #d45b43; 7 Navy body #24374d + Tangerine accents #ee9a54; 8 Chalk body #eee9df + Forest green accents #2e5943; 9 Blush body #e5b8bb + Burgundy accents #713b44; 10 Charcoal body #2d3030 + Acid yellow accents #dde95b. Crest navy ink on light colours; pale ivory ink on dark colours for visibility. Keep only existing bottle branding. No external colour names, labels, numbers, grid rules, header text or callout arrows. No extra bottles, no empty cells, no row-to-row changes in bottle scale. Sophisticated cheerful youthful two-tone colours, refined catalogue quality. Each cell is a clean product colour study; all ten are consistent in perspective and geometry.
